ui.title: Practice presentation
ui.subtitle: petsFollow features for a veterinary practice — care continuity and AI focus.
ui.openDeckDesc: Step-by-step walkthrough: practice features, AI integration and offer.

welcome.headline: petsFollow: prescribed care continuity
welcome.lead: A shared digital animal passport across the practice (Web Pro), field (Pro Light) and owner (client app). Not a second PMS — the follow-up thread between visits.

points.title: Web Pro (practice)
points.desc: Relationship hub, records, messaging, AI reports, calendar and commissions.

points.title: Pro Light (field)
points.desc: Free mobile app for home visits, stables and care partners.

points.title: Client app
points.desc: Owners follow, message and pay for their pet’s care continuity.

pain.headline: The thread breaks between consultations
pain.lead: Without a structured channel, the front desk is overloaded and clinicians lose information continuity.

points.title: Overloaded front desk
points.desc: Calls, personal SMS and scattered emails — nothing lands in the record.

points.title: Broken clinical thread
points.desc: Between visits it is hard to know what was said, prescribed or followed up.

points.title: Fragmented tools
points.desc: PMS, WhatsApp, paper: the team wastes time rebuilding context.

surfaces.headline: Three surfaces, one passport
surfaces.lead: Each actor gets the right interface — the practice remains the control tower.

points.title: VetPro — Web practice
points.desc: Pro SaaS: cockpit, clients, pets, messaging, AI CR, ASV team.

points.title: VetLight — Field mobile
points.desc: Free: field agenda, charts, notes, dictation; structuring AI on Web.

points.title: Client — Owner mobile
points.desc: Per-pet plan: passport, messages, vitals, Care/Horse, household.

vetpro.headline: The practice control tower
vetpro.lead: Everything the care team needs daily to steer the relationship and the animal record.

points.title: Cockpit & clients
points.desc: Dashboard, client file, linked pets, link requests.

points.title: Record & timeline
points.desc: Digital passport: history, visit reports, shares and follow-up events.

points.title: Calendar & team
points.desc: Practice calendar, ASV / secretary roles, profile onboarding.

points.title: Commissions
points.desc: Track client activations that help fund the Pro SaaS.

care_loop.headline: Consultation → message → follow-up
care_loop.lead: Value sits between visits: the practice keeps the thread, the owner stays reassured.

points.title: Consultation
points.desc: New visit, clinical notes, finalize the report.

points.title: Secure messaging
points.desc: Vet ↔ client with push — no more scattered personal SMS.

points.title: Appointments & reminders
points.desc: Appointment requests and Care reminders to sustain follow-up.

points.title: Vitals when prescribed
points.desc: Guided RR 15 / 30 / 60 s validated by the practice — a feature, not the product identity.

ai_in_app.headline: How AI is built into VetPro
ai_in_app.lead: The AI visit-report module is included in Pro: dictation, transcription and improve — no add-on SKU.

points.title: Dictation / transcription
points.desc: The vet dictates; audio is transcribed to speed drafting.

points.title: Improve (AI)
points.desc: Gemini structures and clarifies the report under clinician control.

points.title: Finalize & share
points.desc: The finalized report joins the record and can be visible to the owner.

points.title: Field vs Web
points.desc: Pro Light captures; structuring AI improve happens on Web Pro.

ai_automation.headline: Automations around AI adoption
ai_automation.lead: Beyond the Improve button, petsFollow tracks adoption, nudges practices and alerts the assigned sales rep on friction.

points.title: Activation tracking
points.desc: Admin / sales enables tracking; branded J0 email for first reports.

points.title: Adoption drip
points.desc: J3 / J7 nudges if zero usage, digests and NPS through J60.

points.title: ROI at J60
points.desc: Estimated time saved on finalized reports that used transcribe / improve.

points.title: Friction alerts
points.desc: NPS tags and friction signals reach the assigned commercial for coaching.

ecosystem.headline: Field, owners and partners
ecosystem.lead: The practice prescribes and steers; Pro Light and the client app extend continuity outside the clinic.

points.title: Free Pro Light
points.desc: Mobile vet and care pros: agenda, notes, dossier sharing.

points.title: Paid client app
points.desc: Owners pay for pet follow-up; messaging and passport always on hand.

points.title: ACL sharing
points.desc: Dossier shared with colleagues / care pros with consent — no care↔care chat.

offer.headline: Practice SaaS + client plans
offer.lead: The vet prescribes; the owner pays for follow-up. Activation commissions help cover Pro SaaS.

points.title: Pro steer
points.desc: Recommended 3-year commitment (−10% vs 3× annual) — AI CR included.

points.title: Client steer
points.desc: Triennial plan €95 / 3 years — strongest household price argument.

points.title: Self-funding
points.desc: ≈ 8 triennial activations / month ≈ monthly Pro SaaS equivalent.

close.headline: Ready for a field demo?
close.lead: Anchor positioning (continuity + passport), show a visit with AI CR, then client messaging. AI diagrams detail the automations.

points.title: Key message
points.desc: petsFollow = vet-led care continuity — not a heart-rate app.

points.title: Differentiator
points.desc: AI CR included in Pro + three coherent surfaces (Web, field, client).

points.title: Next
points.desc: Prospect → practice signup → pet activations → commissions.
